test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following was set up in 1956 by the Indian government by nationalising all the existing private sector life insurance companies?

options.text: New India Insurance Company of India Limited

solution:
The correct answer is __**Life Insurance Corporation of India**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Life Insurance Company is a public sector insurance company headquartered in Mumbai that was incorporated by Insurance Act in June 1956.**
 
• It was established on 1st September 1956 and currently, it has 8 zonal offices and over 2000 branch offices.
 
• **In 1956, the government nationalized over 200 private Indian and foreign insurance providers under a roof named LIC. Hence option 3 is correct.**
 
• In 1818, Oriental Life Insurance Company located in Calcutta was the first insurance company in India which was established by Europeans.
 
• The current chairman of LIC M.R. Kumar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The New India Insurance Company of India Limited is India's largest public sector general insurance company headquartered in Mumbai.**
 
• It was founded by Dorabji Tata in 1919 and was incorporated as a limited company then itself.
 
 
• **It was nationalized in 1973** and its current CEO is Atul Sahai.
 
 
 
• **General Insurance Corporation, established in 1972, is a Mumbai-based public sector company that provides reinsurance to general insurance companies** and was incorporated under the Companies Act, of 1956.
 
• **United India Insurance Company Limited is a government-owned insurance company** and was earlier a subsidiary of General Insurance Corporation of India.
 
 
• ​It was incorporated in 1938 and was nationalized in 1972.
